MRI Safety Information
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Fjord Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5T and 3T
• a maximum spatial field gradient of 25-T/m or less
• Maximum gradient slew rate of 150 T/m/s per axis
• B1+RMS of 1.5 µT or less
• head averaged SAR of 0.1 W/kg
• Scanning in the Normal Operating Mode of operation for the MR system
• Limit scanning to one hour of continuous active scan time
• A cooling period of 5 minutes is required between scans
• Use the body transmit coil
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Fjord Aneurysm Clip is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 3.0 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
